name: What is the main purpose of under-cabinet lighting in a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the main purpose of under-cabinet lighting in a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under-cabinet lighting directly illuminates countertop workspaces, eliminating shadows cast by ceiling fixtures and upper cabinetry. During a kitchen remodel, adding task lighting under upper cabinets improves food preparation safety and highlights tile backsplashes and stone countertops. A practical tradeoff involves selecting between hardwired systems and plug-in options. Hardwired fixtures connect directly to wall switches or dimmers for a clean, wire-free look, whereas plug-in fixtures cost less upfront but require visible cords and occupy valuable wall outlets. Integrating this feature early during custom cabinetry and electrical rough-in ensures wires remain completely concealed within the cabinetry framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Under-cabinet lighting provides focused task light on countertops, eliminating shadows cast by overhead fixtures while accenting your backsplash and countertops without visible cords.
